scripts.e2e:setup: [ -f .env.test ] && echo '.env.test already exists' || cp .env.test.example .env.test && echo 'Created .env.test from template — edit it and set JWT_SECRET + QA_SEED_PASSWORD before npm run e2e:up'
scripts.e2e:up: [ -f .env.test ] || (echo 'Missing .env.test — run: npm run e2e:setup' && exit 1) && docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml up -d --build
